basic_profile.bio: G'day! I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast and avid gamer from Melbourne, Australia. By day, I'm a software developer, working on mobile apps, and by night, I'm catching Pokémon and trading spores. I have a keen interest in blockchain technology and often explore new trends in the crypto world. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time exploring the benefits of medicinal cannabis. Typically, I'm online during the evenings, especially on weekends when I have more time to dive into discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Melbourne, I have honed my skills in software development, particularly in mobile applications. My interest in blockchain technology began as a hobby, which I have nurtured through self-teaching and active participation in online forums and communities.
